instruction: Make an order for 4 'Gregory Baltoro 65 Pack's, 3 'TaoTronics LED Desk Lamp's, and 2 'Parrot Anafi Drone's from amazon for my mother's home address.
notes: Two-app task (phone + amazon). The mother's home address is discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship="mother") and then registered on amazon with add_address (evaluation ignores Address additions but forbids updates/deletes, so a new address is added rather than modifying an existing one; its id becomes the place_order address_id). The order must contain exactly the three products with quantities 4/3/2, so the cart is cleared first (clear_cart; equivalently clear_cart_first=true on the first add) and add_product_to_cart is only allowed with the wanted quantity. amazon.place_order carries the three product/quantity pairs as extra record parameters so its precondition asserts the full cart content and its effect empties the cart; thus (order-placed mother-home-address) is true exactly when the correct order has been placed for the mother's address. search_products needs no token. supervisor.complete_task takes the address record as its only (non-API) parameter and no answer since no question is asked.

plan: (amazon-add-address mother-name mother-street mother-city mother-state mother-country mother-zip amazon-token mother-home-address)
(amazon-place-order amazon-card mother-home-address amazon-token gregory-baltoro-65-pack quantity-4 parrot-anafi-drone quantity-2 taotronics-led-desk-lamp quantity-3)
